description: Defines a NotificationManager struct responsible for managing and sending user notifications, including permission handling, content setup, and priority handling.

classes.name: NotificationManager
classes.description: A struct managing the creation and delivery of user notifications, including checking entitlements and handling notification priorities.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a notification with a specified title, body, sound, and optional priority, handling permission requests and logging.
